test_zimage_inpaint_pipeline_inference: test the ZImageInpaintPipeline by running inference with dummy components and verifying output image shape
test_zimage_inpaint_batch_processing: test the ZImageInpaintPipeline batch processing by generating multiple identical images and comparing results
test_zimage_inpaint_strength_parameter: test the ZImageInpaintPipeline strength parameter by comparing outputs with low and high strength values
test_zimage_inpaint_mask_control: test the ZImageInpaintPipeline mask inpainting by comparing full mask and no mask outputs
